correctness.rationale: The isotropic norm equation gives sum(y_i^2)=32a^2. Modulo 8, this forces all y_i even; after writing y_i=2z_i, the equation sum(z_i^2)=8a^2 forces all z_i even, so y_i is divisible by 4. Pairings with the two lattice summands are therefore divisible by 4. The primitive vector (1;4,4,0,0) is isotropic and pairs to -4 with (1,0,1,0) in D4, proving its divisibility is exactly 4. Standard K3 lattice geometry transfers this to the minimum fibration index.

value.rationale: The lattice is singled out in recent work as a K3 example with infinite automorphism group and maximal Mordell–Weil rank zero. The exact minimum multisection index is a natural geometric invariant of that example: it proves every genus-one fibration has index divisible by four and exhibits index four. This distinguishes the example from sectioned, bisection, and trisection fibrations and is useful in understanding its genus-one geometry.
